verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a graphical chat interface is community hands-on reports of Cactus's Android demo chat app. Users called it the fastest offline LLM they had seen on the phone, but reported endless repetition, no auto-scroll, accessibility problems and crashes when selecting downloaded GGUF models. The 'cactus run' CLI and the browser automation demo are not shown to be a graphical chat UI. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a built-in chat GUI, desktop GUI support, a stable model-selection flow, and polish (auto-scroll, dark mode/contrast).

support.subject: As a power-user, I can chat with local models using a built-in graphical chat interface

citations.quote: Android chat app compared to another app tried a year ago: fast and accurate on math, translation, and movie trivia, and called the fastest offline LLM seen on that phone.
Downloading Jan Nano or SmolLM3 via the GGUF link worked, but the app crashed immediately on selecting them.
